notes.title: Hotfix v.0.27
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/441bad129eb1dc1a16f103c10daabf85f65699de.png
Fixed the error that the thief did not notice you.
Fixed the thief from entering the locked door.
3 items were rearranged (there were a few bugs.)
The interaction of the soldier with the house has been rearranged.

notes.title: Update v.0.25 - Thief
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/64c87c627e1075c1eec2429eb910023e9d4c0746.png
Thief added.
Day and night system added.
Fixed no radio use.
Fixed Remote Controller bug.
Fixed jumping bugs.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/208080ead5d850465c95421b3777914c1be3732a.png
A new bed has been added to your home.
You can sleep at night.
Flashlight added.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/adc0d5cf140fd2438d60878a6af6731ad311cf9d.png
You can now lock your doors.
The home market opened.
Buy from the home market. You can install an alarm system in your home.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/441bad129eb1dc1a16f103c10daabf85f65699de.png
At night, soldiers can raid your home. (They must hide before they arrive)
At night, your target becomes more aggressive.
When an error occurred in the game, a button was added that could save you from the place where you were stuck.

notes.title: Update v.0.2 - The Postman is here!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/3e660fe777d1dc73c951a237eacf845f7fbfe8ec.png
Postman added.
The postman comes at random times. Leaves letter inside the mailbox.
If you receive this letter before your target, you can report it.
Report box edited(You can now throw objects easily.)
Bitcoin miner bug fixed.

notes.title: Update v.0.15 - Police Raid
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34239975/71ea2407d25d97f3dc39e712b6d99576d230cca4.png
- Evidance.exe application added (available in the game computer)
- Pass.txt file added to game computer.
- When all the evidence is collected, you can start the investigation and arrange a police raid.
- Added tutorial about the use of the walkie-talkie.
-Japanese language support added.
-A few small bugs have been fixed.
- Added Sensitivity setting.
